selection.reason: The combined rear position, stop and reversing lamps must meet the consolidated light-signalling requirements, including photometry, emitted colour through the outer lens, marking and applicable durability tests.
The integrated molded-prism retro-reflector must satisfy the applicable retro-reflector class requirements for optical performance, colour, marking and durability.
Installation on an M1 passenger car must satisfy the applicable requirements for lamp and reflector number, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical operation.
The LED-on-PCB implementation brings the lamp electronics and their vehicle integration within the applicable electromagnetic-compatibility requirements.
The exposed lens, housing and any accessible fixings form part of an M1 vehicle's exterior and must satisfy applicable external-projection and edge-shape requirements.

The specified rear lighting must retain the required operation and visibility following the prescribed low-speed protective-device impact tests, making lamp design and placement relevant to vehicle compliance.

verworfen (nur Fahrzeugebene): The stop-lamp function depends on the braking-system signal whose generation is regulated by UN R13H, although these requirements concern the supplying braking system rather than the lamp's optical performance.

verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the LED implementation uses a standardized LED light-source category listed in Annex 1, that source must meet UN R128 requirements, but integral PCB LED modules alone do not establish this applicability.
Its rear-position and stop-lamp provisions are consolidated into UN R148, which is selected instead.
Its reversing-lamp provisions are consolidated into UN R148, which is selected instead.
Its retro-reflector provisions are consolidated into UN R150, which is selected instead.
The scope expressly excludes glazing for lighting and light-signalling devices, so the PMMA outer lens is not safety glazing under this regulation.
The specified reversing lamp falls under UN R148; no headlamp, front fog lamp, cornering lamp or other UN R149 road-illumination function is specified.
